giordanos.name: Giordano's

brooklinen.name: Brooklinen
brooklinen.why: Weekly pick: bundle builder, compare, reviews.

imperial-tropicals.name: Imperial Tropicals
imperial-tropicals.why: PDP variant pills by size + sex: 0.5-1" Female / Male / Pair (1M,1F) / Trio (1M,2F). Pairs and trios are how hobbyists actually buy livebearers, and the dark hero puts a guppy on black under 'Buy directly from the breeder'. PDP section 'Our Healthy & Happy Arrival guarantee' ('packing and shipping live fish for over 50 years'), a FAQ entry 'How do you ship live fish? Sounds risky!', a Google-rating review wall on the PDP, and scientific names (Poecilia reticulata) on cards.

dans-fish.name: Dan's Fish
dans-fish.why: PDP 'Listing' buttons by sex and grade (Male-B Grade / Female-B Grade / Male / Female) beside a large photo, a thumbnail strip and an In-stock dot. The description is structured as Source / Estimated size at shipping / Adult size. Header marquee: Next Day Air $39.99 in the continental US 'no matter how many fish you buy'. PDP copy covers quarantine/medication protocols and a Certified Aquatic Veterinarian. Homepage has 'Choose the perfect pet', customer-success reviews and an embedded YouTube video.

aqua-huna.name: Aqua Huna
aqua-huna.why: Hero banner 'We offer 3-Day Live Arrival Guarantee / UPS Next Day Air Flat Rate $29.99' puts the trust promise first. Collection cards show live stock counts ('In stock, 60 units'). PDP: 'Sold in packs/multiples of 6', 'Individually priced', a 100% live arrival guarantee for Aqua Huna brand animals, 'For DOA refunds: Photo is required', 'Domestic shipping only... cannot ship to Hawaii & Washington State'. Availability/price filters.

flip-aquatics.name: Flip Aquatics
flip-aquatics.why: PDP with two variant pickers: Origin (Flip Bred / Imported) x Quantity (Juvie (Unsexed) / Male / Female / Pair (M/F)), plus a water-parameter list (pH 7.2-8.2, KH 4-6, GH 8-12, TDS 150-200, Temp 72-80) and a feeding/plant guide. Collection cards carry star ratings. '100% live-arrival guarantee when shipping with Overnight (1 day) option. All other options void our live arrival guarantee for fish.' Flat-rate FedEx Priority Overnight $34.99, free over $200 (announcement bar).

tropical-fish-co.name: Tropical Fish Co
tropical-fish-co.platform: Headless: Next.js front end; product images served from cdn.shopify.com, /products.json 404, so probably Shopify behind a custom storefront (not confirmed)
tropical-fish-co.why: Product cards that show care chips on every card (e.g. 22-28°C · pH 7-8 · 41L), plus PDP shoal-size price tiers (1 / 6 / 10 / 20 fish, 'Minimum healthy shoal') with a sticky Add-to-Basket bar. 'Live arrival guaranteed. If they don't arrive healthy, email us a short unboxing video the same day for a replacement or refund.' Oxygenated bags, insulation and heat packs; licensed live-animal courier; £19.95 tracked delivery (half price from £100, free from £200). Care Guide, Tank Mates / tank-mate checker, stocking calculator and an 'Ask Aqua' AI helper.

fishlist-sg.name: Fishlist.sg
fishlist-sg.why: PDP variant grid sex (MALE/FEMALE) x pack size (5pc/10pc/50pc), a free-shipping progress bar ('Free shipping for orders over $80.00') and Shop Pay. Collection cards have sale % badges and 'View options' buttons. 'Guaranteed Healthy on Arrival' tick on the PDP, short care requirements in the description ('Ensure compatibility with other tank mates'), and a homepage 'Collection list' with species tiles.

guppie-au.name: guppie.au
guppie-au.platform: No (no Shopify markers; custom stack behind Cloudflare)
guppie-au.why: PDP 'Purchase Options' card with Pair (1M/1F) / Trio (1M/2F), a photo+video gallery, and 'Australia-wide shipping · Quality guaranteed' right under the CTA. The copy is upfront that juveniles ship smaller than the adults shown on video. 'No shipping to WA, NT, TAS'. 'Want to see the exact fish before dispatch? Add a note at checkout and we will send a short video the night before shipping'. The FAQ (from search) has a DOA policy needing an unopened-bag video within 3 hours. Category & tag filter on the shop page.

wild-one.name: Wild One
wild-one.why: Product cards with colour-swatch dots + '+4 colors', Best Seller / Kit & Save badges and lifestyle photography. The PDP pairs colour swatches + size pills + Size Chart, benefit icons, an accordion (Description, Product Details, Care & Caution, FAQs, Shipping & Returns) and a 'Make It A Walk Kit' cross-sell with inline variant selects. n/a (non-livestock design benchmark). Free-shipping threshold bar ('Free Shipping on Orders $80+').
